goals.0: Cause and effect: deshalb, deswegen, daher, dadurch
grammar.0.note: deshalb/daher/darum are adverbs: at the start of a sentence the verb is in 2nd position. weil is a subordinate clause: verb at the end.
grammar.1.note: In speech people often use wegen + Dativ: „wegen dem Wetter“ — in writing the Genitiv is correct.
grammar.2.note: wurde / wurden + Partizip II — very common in news and reports.
